That would be the next objective for the bulls, of course. So we continue to track the same micro support area here between $80.19 and $82 and $55. This is the very same micro support area I was tracking before, and so, against to support, the focus can still be on higher prices, but at they, I'd say the focus is, or let's say the outlook is cautious, because there's more than bullish and bearish, this is a cautious outlook at really, only it only makes sense to look for higher as long as this swing low is holding on Tuesday. Yeah, this Tuesday low that from that 80 dollars and 20. If we break below it it opens the door to lower support here in the area around 78, 75, 71 dollars. I've said it before, many times there is probably some Fibonacci confluence and structural support confluence in this area around $75 to $78. This is where we had previous swing lows, this is where the Golden Ratio level formed. This is where we have the next larger degree support level. Hold, I cannot see it here on this time frame. 74, $88. So, on don't even see it here on this time frame here 74.88 yeah so the market is still um the market is still uh yeah you say not out of the woods yet not out of the woods yet and so i'm watching specifically the tuesday low here as key support for the bulls and the break break above the 8460 level or 8460 to 88, sorry, 8460 to 8490. That would be the first, let's say, real breakout level and signal level that the bulls are really taking the lead here and could take the price higher in a third wave of a third wave even. And if we push above these last swing highs from this week, and it's a big if, yeah, then the next resistance levels, I'd say the main key area here to watch then will be around $87.62. That's the golden ratio level, a very important Fib level. And then $90.11 and then we've got this yellow trend line go through here as well, which is just an additional area of resistance basically.
